title: Autopsy: detecting vulnerabilities in AI-generated code by reasoning across dependency graphs
description:
Autopsy is a static-plus-LLM vulnerability detector aimed at AI-generated code. It builds a cross-file dependency graph, scans code in windows so that large files are not limited by a single pass's output budget, and includes deterministic detectors for deletion-based ("zero-footprint") vulnerabilities, where removing a comment boundary or a security control introduces a vulnerability that never appears as an added line in a diff.

This release is the reproducibility artifact accompanying the paper. It contains the detection pipeline, the benchmark harnesses (pygoat, SecurityEval, a Flask demo, and a TypeScript demo), and the Semgrep, Bandit, and CodeQL security-extended baselines scored through a frozen matcher.
